intro.title: Amber Stone
intro.description: Amber is fossilised tree resin formed over millions of years beneath the earth. The resin has to undergo and survive through various forces such as extremely high or low temperature, rain, exposure to sunlight, bacteria, and more to turn into Amber. The beautiful luster of Amber stone makes it look incredibly stunning, when worn as a ring, pendant, or bracelet. The warm amber color of this stone illuminates elegance and splendor.

tabs.tab1_description:
Amber Gemstone is a semi-precious stone growing organically, and the older it is, the more powerful it is. This warm-hued stone radiates like the sun and carries tremendous energies. Its name is derived from the Lower Saxon word "Börnen," meaning "burning". Since it stays underground for years, tiny insects and creatures get trapped in the resin during its process of solidifying or fossilizing. Amber is categorized as an organic gemstone. The most interesting thing about this stone is that it develops magical properties and imbues Earth's energy during its formation.

Amber gemstone is known as a protective talisman that dispels negativity and heals the wearer. Natural Amber has the potential to generate positive energies that uplift the mood. It is said to carry the wisdom of Earth and bestow the wearer with enhanced concentration to meditate. This excellent stone can be worn to detoxify your mind, body, and soul. It helps heal the energy of the wearer and connects an individual with his/her higher self. It is deeply associated with sensuality, persistence, creativity, healing, cleansing, and protection. It blesses the wearer with mental power and a clear mind.

Amber's origin is fossilized tree resin, despite the fact that it is considered a gem. This organic substance is frequently employed in the creation of jewelry and ornamental objects. Amber is typically orange or brown and has a range of transparencies. It measures from 1 to 3 on the Mohs scale of hardness. Amber signifies purification and renewal.

The amber gemstone has long been a source of intrigue for crystal enthusiasts due to its ancient energy and rich natural warmth. Amber, which straddles the line between precious gem and ancient tree, carries the weight and knowledge of countless eons within it.

Amber is the vital force of ancient trees, and it brings all of that vitality into the present. It infuses us with a feeling of nourishment, activates our sacral chakra, and provides us with all the tools and encouraging vibrations necessary for complete self-healing.

Amber's golden luminosity and beautiful energy brings emotional warmth. Since it has insects or little creatures trapped during fossilization, it holds the essence of life within.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Amber gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Amber. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Sacral Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Amber can be worn by adults as well as kids to imbibe the healing benefits. Usually, it is believed that children can get relief during teething by wearing Amber gemstone. Individuals having muscular pain can also wear this stone. Those who have inflammatory pain can wear Amber as it releases succinic acid that soothes the skin.

Sunstone gemstone is recommended for people with anxiety issues. Amber accessories can also be worn by individuals with dehydrated and hyperpigmented skin.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Amber gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Amber gemstones.

Amber Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

The main source of amber is along the Baltic Sea's southern shores in Poland (formerly East Prussian). It's also found in marine deposits off the coasts of East Germany, Sicily, the Mediterranean Sea off the coast of Sicily, and Upper Burma and Romania.

Observe their Color:

Amber gemstone has slight variations in color, and it comes in different shades of yellow to orange. One variant is in light yellow with a golden sheen, while some stones have an orange hue. Baltic Amber formed from the resin of conifer, and there are more varieties like genadite, stantanite, and beckerite. Genadite is light yellow and shiny, Stantanite comes in dull black color and is opaque, and Beckerite is brown.

Notice their Clarity

Amber is commonly translucent as opposed to transparent. Amber can vary in clarity depending on the specimen, but it is valued more for its unique and natural appearance than for its clarity or lack of inclusions.

Examine their Inclusions:

Amber will exhibit a "Sun spangle" effect after being heated in oil. Additionally, stones may contain gas bubbles and flow lines. Occasionally associated with insects and other organic and inorganic materials. Sometimes, the dividing layers of the original material are visible in stones formed from compressed amber fragments. These inclusions are frequently prized because they can offer unique and intriguing patterns or specimens that provide a glimpse into prehistoric times.

See their Shape:

Amber is frequently shaped into oval or spherical shapes, facilitating the stringing of beads and the creation of lovely necklaces and bracelets. Additionally, it is typically found in round, cushion, pear, and square shapes.

Check the Carats:

For Amber of gem quality, the raw Amber is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Amber weighing 3 carats and above are appropriate for jewelry. Because Amber is sold by weight, Amber prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Amber has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Amber

Due to treatments the Amber stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Amber do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Amber gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Amber are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Amber from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Amber gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Amber gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Amber is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

The best quality amber gemstones are gleaming orange and yellow with golden tones.

Cut

Best quality amber gemstones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Amber of 3 carats and above is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Amber are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Amber rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Best quality amber gemstones have intense and vivid honey-like colors.

Traders deal in Amber stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Amber gemstone Price

The price of Amber gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. In the case of amber, the inclusions are often a deciding factor in the price, even though most ambers are sold free of these. Rich saturation of color is key.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Amber has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Amber stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Amber gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 9,035 to INR 11,015 (USD 112 to USD 137).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Amber?

The best way to check the authenticity of Amber is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Amber are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Amber carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that an Amber is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Amber have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Amber, but if you find flaws, then your Amber is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Amber are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Amber. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Amber, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Amber from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Amber. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Amber. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Amber Cleaning & Maintenance

Amber is softer than most gemstone minerals and many other organic substances. It falls between a Mohs hardness of 2 and 2.5. Amber is also fragile, so care must be taken not to scratch or damage it when wearing it.

Amber burns at temperatures that are relatively low. It may also darken with prolonged exposure to light and can be harmed by chemicals.

Amber can only be safely cleaned with warm, soapy water.

Always use a mild soap.
